title: Language
summary: The site's language picker. From two languages a button with the translate glyph, the current code and expand_more («RU ▾», one width whatever is chosen) opens a menu at the C32 panel width, each row the name in itself and its name in the page's language beside it; eight and more the same menu with search, on a phone a sheet at the bottom. A settings page can write mode="inline" for a segmented switch (the arrows move, Enter chooses), a form mode="field" for a dropdown field with its label; an app menu takes SfLanguage.menuEntry() for its «Язык» row. A language without this page stays, marked «нет перевода — откроется главная». One language draws nothing. A choice is a cancellable change; then the element follows the language's href or applies the language to the page (SF.language.use, lang and dir on <html>).

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

languages.description: The languages, as BCP 47 codes separated by spaces or commas: «ru en de ar», «pt-BR». Each is named in itself and in English: the names of the 66 languages the component supports ship with it (data/names.json, CLDR), the browser (Intl.DisplayNames) names any other. items, when given, takes its place

href.description: The address of the site in each language, as a pattern with {code}: «/{code}/» gives /ru/ and /en/. A language with its own href keeps it. A language with an href is followed, not applied in the page

missing.description: The languages this page has no translation of, as codes («de fr»; owner decision C142 (6)). They stay in the list, each menu row with the line «нет перевода — откроется главная» under its name, and a choice goes to home in that language

home.description: The address of the site's main page in each language, as a pattern with {code} («/{code}/»): where a language of missing goes. Not set, a missing language goes to its own href

mode.description: The look. auto: two languages and more are a button with the current code («RU ▾») and a menu (menu), eight and more the menu with search (search), on a phone a sheet at the bottom -- one button for every count (owner decision C142). inline is the segmented switch, for a settings page where every language is in sight (the arrows move, Enter or Space chooses); field is a form field (sf-dropdown with its label above, C142 (8)); menu and search fix those looks. One language draws nothing in every mode

inline-max.description: In auto mode, the most languages drawn as a segmented switch; 1, the default since 1.4.0 (owner decision C142), never: auto draws the button and menu from two languages. A settings page writes mode="inline" for the switch

search-from.description: In auto mode, the number of languages from which the menu has a search field

labels.description: What the switch's segments say: name, the language's name in itself (Русский · English); code, its code (RU · EN), each segment keeping the name as its accessible name. The menu and the trigger are not affected: the trigger shows the code. The former boolean compact is a dated alias of labels="code" (owner decision C134: compact means density only; noted in SF.deprecations until 2027-01-01, journal attribute-language-compact-to-labels-code)

size.description: The ladder rung: the trigger is a button of that size, the switch a segmented control of that size; the menu's rows are 32 px up to 1/2 and 40 px from 1. 1/2 fits the tools slot of sf-header-site

apply.description: What a choice of a language without an href does after its change event: page sets it for the page (SF.language.use(code), lang and dir on <html>); none only changes the value, for a settings form the server applies

remember.description: A name to keep the choice under: the chosen code is a preference of the person (SF.Preferences key sf-language/<name>; in the browser localStorage sf-pref:sf-language/<name>, and a host that keeps preferences for its user gets it). Reading it back before the first paint is the site's (docs.md); the element shows the language of <html lang>

label.description: The control's name: the switch's group and the menu are named by it, the trigger by it and the current language's name in itself, «Язык: Русский» (the code the trigger shows is not its name). «Язык» / «Language» in the page language when not set

name.description: Native form field name: the element submits the chosen code with its form, a form reset restores the value it was written with, and a disabled element is left out

disabled.description: Disables the trigger or the switch

value.description: The chosen language's code. Not set, the element shows the language of <html lang> when it is one of the list (the same code, else the same primary language), else the first

items.description: The languages as a list, each {code, label?, short?, href?, missing?}: label replaces the shipped or browser name («Қазақша» written otherwise), short the code the trigger and labels="code" show, href the address of the site in that language, missing true for a language this page has no translation of (as missing). A property, or the JSON island a server prints; when it holds a language it is the list, and languages is not read

select.summary: Chooses a language by its code as a press would, sending change with reason api: refused {reason: unknown} for a code not in the list, {reason: unchanged} for the shown one, {reason: disabled}, {reason: prevented} when a page cancels change

change.summary: A language was chosen: the request, sent before anything changes. Cancelled, nothing changes (the switch goes back) -- a site that navigates itself (a router, a Docara page that keeps its path) cancels it and goes. Not cancelled, the value is the code, remember keeps it, and the element goes to href, or with apply page applies the language to the page. The name to bind

href.description: The language's address; empty when it has none.

reason.description: A person's press, or select() from code.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: translating the page's own content (the site serves each language)
restoring a remembered language before the first paint (the site's inline script)
keeping the rest of the path when a site switches /ru/... to /en/... (cancel change and navigate)

keyboard: Inline (mode="inline"): Tab reaches the chosen language; the arrows, Home and End move the focus between languages and choose nothing; Enter or Space chooses (C142 (4))
Menu (auto from two languages): Tab reaches the trigger «RU ▾»; Enter or Space opens the menu; the arrows move, a letter jumps, Enter chooses; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger

Search: the field takes focus when the menu opens; Down moves to the rows. The menu opens with the chosen language in view; without a search the chosen row takes the focus. On a phone's sheet (from search-from languages) no field takes the focus: the chosen row does
accessibility.focus: After a choice in the menu, focus returns to the trigger; in the switch it stays on the chosen segment.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-language once in a site header (sf-header-site's tools slot at size 1/2) to choose the site's language from a list of codes: a button «RU ▾» and a menu from two languages. On a settings page where every language should be in sight write mode="inline" (a segmented switch).
do_not: Do not draw flags or a globe for languages; the element uses the translate glyph and the names
Do not give a supported language a label of your own to fix its name; the component ships the names of its languages (data/names.json) and the browser names the rest
Do not use sf-language for a country or a region; it picks languages
Do not build a separate switch for two languages and a menu for many; one element is the same button and menu for every count, and mode="inline" is the switch of a settings page
